features.featureTitle: Fix the post re-sign-in loading failure where the Events and Tasks views show errors like “Failed to load tasks” / “Failed to load events” after the user signs out and signs back in, by ensuring the backend actor is reliably recreated/refetched whenever the Internet Identity session changes (even when the user logs back in as the same principal). Update the actor React Query cache key and refetch behavior so `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(...)` runs for the new session and subsequent calls do not trap as unauthorized/stale-session.

Update React Query caching for calendar data so events/tasks queries are scoped to the currently authenticated principal (and do not reuse cached error/data across sign-out/sign-in cycles). Specifically, adjust the query keys used by the events and tasks queries so they change when the signed-in principal changes, and ensure queries refetch cleanly after re-authentication and unlock.

Harden the encryption unlock state handling so unlocking cannot leave the UI in an inconsistent state during re-sign-in flows. Ensure the encryption session “isUnlocking” state updates via Zustand state updates (not by mutating the store object directly), and that lock/unlock transitions do not prevent calendar queries from running when prerequisites (actor + key) are satisfied.
